review.en: This Sono Cairo LP holds a single song across its two sides: Enta Omri, the first work Mohammed Abdel Wahab composed for Umm Kulthum, with words by Ahmed Shafik Kamel. The meeting of the two biggest names in Egyptian music was a public event, and the song became one of the best known in the Arab world. Its long instrumental introduction and slowly varied refrains show tarab built on patience.
review.zh: 这张 Sono Cairo 黑胶两面只收一首歌：《你是我的生命》，穆罕默德·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜为乌姆·库勒苏姆谱写的第一首作品，词作者艾哈迈德·沙菲克·卡迈勒。埃及乐坛两位最大的名字相遇，本身就是一件公共大事，这首歌也成为阿拉伯世界最知名的歌曲之一。长长的器乐引子和缓慢变化的复唱，是建立在耐心之上的塔拉布。
